en.title: Ratio Tune — Live Radio
en.subtitle: 50,000+ stations worldwide
en.short_description: Stream 50,000+ live radio stations worldwide. Free, no account, sleep timer.
en.description:
Ratio Tune is a live radio player. It opens straight to the stations people are listening to right now, and everything works without an account.

—— Listen ——

WORLDWIDE
Over 50,000 working stations from 241 countries, drawn from the open Radio Browser directory. Stations flagged as broken are filtered out before you ever see them.

BY GENRE
Music, news and talk, browsable by tag.

NEAR YOU
Allow location once and Ratio Tune finds stations broadcasting around you. The location is used for that query and nothing else.

SEARCH
Find a station by name.

—— Keep listening ——

• Background playback with lock-screen and notification controls
• Sleep timer from 15 to 120 minutes
• Favourites, saved on your device
• A dark interface with a live audio visualiser

—— Private by default ——

No account. No sign-up. No advertising and no analytics SDK. Ratio Tune stores your favourites on the device and asks for nothing about you.

—— A note on the stations ——

Streams are published by third-party broadcasters through the Radio Browser directory. Availability and content are theirs, not ours: a station can go offline or change format at any time, and we do not control what is broadcast.
en.full_description:
Ratio Tune is a live radio player. It opens straight to the stations people are listening to right now, and everything works without an account.

LISTEN
• Over 50,000 working stations from 241 countries, via the open Radio Browser directory
• Music, news and talk, browsable by genre tag
• Stations broadcasting near you, if you allow location
• Search any station by name

KEEP LISTENING
• Background playback with lock-screen and notification controls
• Sleep timer, 15 to 120 minutes
• Favourites, saved on your device
• Dark interface with a live audio visualiser

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no sign-up, no advertising SDK and no analytics. Favourites stay on your device. Location, if you grant it, is used only to look up nearby stations.

ABOUT THE STATIONS
Streams come from third-party broadcasters listed in the Radio Browser directory. Availability and content are theirs: a station may go offline or change format at any time.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Ratio Tune.

Ratio Tune is a live radio player. No account and no sign-in are required, and every feature is reachable on first launch. Audio comes from third-party broadcasters listed in the open Radio Browser directory (api.radio-browser.info); the app hosts no streams of its own.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app. Home lists the most-played stations worldwide - tap any one to start playing. No account or sign-in is involved.
2. Open the full-screen player from the mini player at the bottom for artwork, the audio visualiser, the favourite (heart) button and share.
3. Tap the sleep timer in the player and choose an interval (15-120 minutes).
4. Open the Radio tab to browse by genre, or Search to find a station by name.
5. From the Radio tab, open Discover and allow location when prompted to list stations broadcasting near you. Declining leaves every other feature working.
6. Open the Favorites tab to see the stations you hearted. They are stored on the device only and are never uploaded.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Nothing about you. There is no account, no sign-up and no profile. Favourite stations are stored on the device with shared_preferences and are never uploaded.
• Network: Station metadata is fetched from the open Radio Browser directory (api.radio-browser.info) and audio is streamed directly from the broadcaster's own server. No analytics or advertising SDK is present in the build.
• Location: Optional and coarse. If you allow it, an approximate position is sent to the Radio Browser directory once to list nearby stations. It is not stored, not logged and not used for anything else. Declining leaves every other feature working.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier, so no App Tracking Transparency prompt appears.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
